changelog:
• Dynamic Engine Brand Logos & Hints: Dedicated vector brand logos for Google, Brave, DuckDuckGo, and Startpage. Automatically displays active engine in top input card and hint, with permanent persistence across app restarts.
• Three-Dots Quick Navigation Bar: Integrated Back, Forward, Home, Save Page, and Downloads buttons in a single toolbar above the protection card with smart page-state dimming.
• Biometric Lock Security Fix: Mandatory fingerprint or PIN verification before allowing private tab lock to be disabled.
• Save Page & Offline Reading: Added 1-tap web page archiving (.mhtml) and bookmarks list.
• Modernized 3-Dots Menu: Upgraded all accents from legacy cyan to modern Firefox mobile purple (#7C6CF6).
